from common import *
from backtest.scripts.prepare.prepare_regime_train_chunks import cache_lock,_atomic_json

save_source(__file__)
root=FEATURE.parents[2]
paths=[FEATURE,OLD_LABEL,VALID]
receipt=root/'.references/pathsum-quantile10-p50-20261107-v1.json'
old_ref=read(PREVIOUS/'docs/cache-reference.json');check(old_ref)
prior=read(ROOT/old_ref['path'])
assert set(map(str,paths))<=set(prior['manifests'])
with cache_lock(root):
 journal=root/'.cleanup-journal.json'
 if journal.exists():assert not {r['manifest'] for r in read(journal)['targets']}.intersection(map(str,paths))
 assert all(p.is_file() and p.is_relative_to(root) for p in paths)
 value={'owner_experiment':EID,'owner_archive':str(BASE.relative_to(ROOT)),'reference_kind':'retained_research_input','manifests':list(map(str,paths)),'retention_reason':'Frozen shared inputs for raw path-sum and H7/H15 quantile10 research with matched H20 controls','release_condition':'Release only after owner explicitly retired and all dependencies checked.'}
 if receipt.exists():assert read(receipt)==value
 else:_atomic_json(receipt,value)
write(BASE/'docs/cache-reference.json',fingerprint(receipt))
write(BASE/'docs/cache-reference-audit.json',{'at':time.time(),'study_reference_created_at_closeout':True,'existing_protection_during_run':old_ref,'same_three_manifests_already_pinned_by_prior_study':True,'new_owner_reference':fingerprint(receipt)})
print('Persistent study-owned shared-input reference created; prior study protection verified.',flush=True)
